goal: Deserialisation review: untrusted data turned into objects, with type control and size limits.
use: Deserialisation review: untrusted data turned into objects, with type control and size limits. Use when code reads serialised data from outside the process.

steps.note: Find the readers. List each place serialised data is read.
Check the format. Flag binary or polymorphic formats read from untrusted sources.
Check types. Flag readers that choose the type from the input.
Check limits. Flag readers with no size or depth limit.
Report. Each reader with file and line, severity and the fix.
